FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification number RD 131 PFH 2022 Dated:
27-06-2022 regarding altering the limits of Savadi village of Athani taluk and
Belagavi dist And constituting a new revenue village called Savadi Darga was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act
1964(Karnataka Act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 131 PFH 2022
Dated:02-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected there by within thirty days from the date of its publications in the official
Gazette.
And where as the said Gazatte was made available to the public on Date:
17-11-2021. And where as objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government.
Now there fore in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act 1964(Karnataka Act no.12 of 1964) The government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification namely
SCHEDULE –1

Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
villages of Savadi Village of Athani Taluk, in Belgaum District to form a New
revenue village called as Savadi Darga of Athani Taluk and Belgaum District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 91 PFH 2022 Dated:16-06-2022
regarding altering the limits of Yadur village of Chikkodi Taluk and Belagavi
District and constituting a new revenue village called Hosayadur, Yadurwadi was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964

(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD 91 PFH 2022
Dated: 02-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:30-01-2023 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Chikkodi taluk in Belagavi District to form a new revenue village called
Hosayadur of Chikkodi taluk Belagavi district along with survey numbers included
in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 07 GLH 2022,
Dated:19/01/2022 regarding altering the limits of Kadalaveni village of
Gowribidanur Taluk, Chikkaballapura District and constituting a new revenue
village called Channenahalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No.
RD 07 GLH 2022 Dated:20/04/2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.

And Whereas, the said Gazette was made available to the public on
Date:13/05/2022 and Whereas, no objections and suggestions are received.

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Gowribidanur taluk in Chikkaballapur District to form a new revenue
village called as Channenahalli of Gowribidanur taluk, Chikkaballapur district
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 89 GLH 2022, Dated : 05/07/2022
regarding altering the limits of Chuncharayanapalli village of Bagepalli Taluk,
Chikkaballapura District and constituting a new revenue village called
Bommayyagarahalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD
89 GLH 2022 Dated: 22/07/2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And Whereas, the said Gazette was made available to the public on 10-08-2022
and Whereas, no objections and suggestions are received.
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Bagepalli taluk in Chikkaballapur District to form a new revenue village
called as Bommayyagarahalli of Bagepalli taluk, Chikkaballapur district along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 85 GLH 2022, Dated : 05/07/2022
regarding altering the limits of Doddanancherlu village of Gudibande Taluk,
Chikkaballapura District and constituting a new revenue village called
Pemmanahalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD
85 GLH 2022 Dated: 22/07/2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the

persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And Whereas, the said Gazette was made available to the public on 25/08/2022
and Whereas, no objections and suggestions are received.
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas specified
in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said village of
Gudibande taluk in Chikkaballapur District to form a new revenue village called as
Pemmanahalli of Gudibande taluk, Chikkaballapur district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 127 GLH 2022, Dated :
05/12/2022 regarding altering the limits of Kotthakote village of Bagepalli Taluk,
Chikkaballapura District and constituting a new revenue village called Krishnapura
was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD 127 GLH 2022
Dated: 06/12/2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And Whereas, the said Gazette was made available to the public on 10/01/2023
and Whereas, no objections and suggestions are received.

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Bagepalli taluk in Chikkaballapur District to form a new revenue village
called as Krishnapura of Bagepalli taluk, Chikkaballapur district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date :08-03-2023.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 15 GLH 2022, Dated : 25/01/2022
regarding altering the limits of Pathapalya village of Bagepalli Taluk,
Chikkaballapura District and constituting a new revenue village called Bukkanahalli
and Gudihalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD 15 GLH
2022 Dated: 27/01/2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely
to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And Whereas, the said Gazette was made available to the public on 18/05/2022
and Whereas, no objections and suggestions are received.
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Bagepalli taluk in Chikkaballapur District to form a new revenue village
called as Bukkanahalli of Bagepalli taluk, Chikkaballapur district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 11 GLH 2022 Dated:
25-01-2022 regarding altering the limits of Banasgeri village of Haliyal Taluk and
Uttar kannad District and constituting a new revenue village called
Hosahadagali was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD

11 GLH 2022 dated:-25-01-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:-
27-01-2022 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Land bearing Survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Banasgeri of Haliyal Taluk, in Uttar kannad District to form new revenue
village called Hosahadagali of Murkwad Hobli, Haliyal Taluk, in Uttar kannad
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 28 GLH 2022, Dated : 02/03/2022
regarding altering the limits of Thondebhavi village of Gowribidanur Taluk,

Bellachikkanahalli and Muttukadahalli was published as required by section 6 of
the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the

Karanataka Gazette No. RD 28 GLH 2022 Dated: 07/04/2022 inviting objections or
suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from
the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

and Whereas, no objections and suggestions are received.

Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-

village of Gowribidanur taluk in Chikkaballapur District to form a new revenue
village called as Bellachikkanahalli of Gowribidanur taluk, Chikkaballapur district
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.
